info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Decision Management API
info.description: The Loan Decision Management API facilitates the removal of specific loan application decisions based on their unique identifiers. This enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and update the status of loan applications by eliminating outdated or erroneous decisions. Typical consumers include loan officers and application management systems that require accurate decision tracking and history management. By using this API, developers can ensure up-to-date decision records that adhere to business protocols and enhance operational integrity.

delete.summary: Delete a specific loan application decision.
delete.description: This endpoint allows the user to delete a loan application decision identified by the unique resource identifier. Ensure that the decision is not required for any ongoing processes before deletion.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific decision associated with the loan application identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the necessary conditions for deletion are met before sending the request.

204.description: The resource was successfully deleted with no content returned.

DeleteLoanApplicationDecisionRes100045Re.description: This schema represents the JSON request body for deleting a loan application decision.
